newsitem.title: USA: Japan recovery seen sustainable - BOJ governor.
newsitem.headline: Japan recovery seen sustainable - BOJ governor.

text.p: Bank of Japan Governor Yasuo Matsushita said Tuesday that Japan's current economic recovery will likely continue without any additional fiscal measures to boost the economy.
Private consumption and corporate capital spending are starting to gather strength in the current economy, which will have a big impact on the move toward a self-sustainable recovery, he said.
He added that for now the brightness in the economy is enough to overwrite the wearing off of the fiscal stimulus package formed last year.
"The brightness for now is enough to swallow up the decrease in fiscal spending," Matsushita said.
